markets.groupItemTitle: Draw (FC Bayern München vs. 1. FC Heidenheim 1846)

eventMetadata.context_description: The FC Bayern München vs. 1. FC Heidenheim 1846 Bundesliga match at Allianz Arena ended in a 3-3 draw on May 2, 2026, resolving trader consensus to 100% on Draw as the dominant outcome. Bayern coach Vincent Kompany heavily rotated the squad with seven changes—including benching Harry Kane, Joshua Kimmich, and Michael Olise initially—ahead of their Champions League semi-final second leg against PSG, allowing bottom-of-the-table Heidenheim, fighting relegation, to lead 2-0 at halftime through Budu Zivzivadze and Eren Dinkçi before Leon Goretzka's brace equalized. Zivzivadze restored Heidenheim's advantage, but Olise's stoppage-time strike off an Alphonso Davies assist from a corner salvaged the point amid Bayern's 75% possession and 23-12 shot edge. With the result official, no realistic challenges remain.

title: QatarEnergy announces/resumes LNG production in Qatar by April 30?
description:
QatarEnergy, a Qatari state-owned petroleum company, announced on March 2 that it would halt production of liquefied natural gas (LNG) due to military strikes on its operating facilities (see: https://www.qatarenergy.qa/en/MediaCenter/Pages/newsdetails.aspx?ItemId=3892).

This market will resolve to “Yes” if QatarEnergy resumes production of liquefied natural gas at QatarEnergy LNG production facilities in Qatar, or officially announces that such production has resumed or will resume, by April 30, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

QatarEnergy resuming the production of other halted products, including downstream LNG-related products, or resuming transportation of LNG without resuming production, will not alone count.

An official announcement that LNG production will resume at QatarEnergy LNG production facilities in Qatar must signal the end of the total LNG production halt effective immediately or on a specific date or clearly defined time window. Mere statements that production will resume at some undefined point in the future, or that production will resume once the halt has ended, will not count.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from QatarEnergy (https://www.qatarenergy.qa/en/Pages/vHome.aspx); however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: Following a March 2026 halt of LNG production at Ras Laffan and Mesaieed facilities due to military strikes prompting force majeure declarations, trader consensus reflects near-certainty after an April 8 ceasefire enabled QatarEnergy to mobilize engineers for rapid restarts. Reuters and other reports confirmed preparations, with some trains already back online—two of three at key plants—positioning full resumption well ahead of the April 30 deadline amid easing Gulf tensions. Realistic shifts remain slim but could arise from unresolved damage assessments delaying official announcements or disputes over partial versus full production metrics for market resolution.

eventMetadata.context_description: Philadelphia 76ers face Boston Celtics in a winner-take-all Game 7 of their Eastern Conference first-round playoff series, tied 3-3 after Philly's 106-93 Game 6 victory on April 30 that held Boston under 100 points for the second straight game behind Tyrese Maxey's 30 points and stout defense. eventMetadata.context_description: Top Esports enters the LPL Split 2 Group Ascend BO3 atop the standings at 7-3, bolstered by key roster additions like ex-Weibo Gaming jungler Tian—who hit 5500 LPL assists in their latest clash—and rookie top laner ZUIAN amid 369's early-season struggles. Weibo Gaming sits seventh at 3-8, hampered by outflows including Tian and Breathe, limiting their macro execution on Patch 26.7. Head-to-head splits evenly after WBG's 2-0 upset on April 28 broke TES's streak, but TES rebounded with dominant form, eyeing top-4 playoffs advancement in this high-stakes group stage rematch. Trader consensus reflects TES's superior recent tournament results, depth, and revenge motivation.

title: Indian Premier League: Chennai Super Kings vs Mumbai Indians
description:

This market resolves according to the finalized match result as published by https://www.espncricinfo.com/.  

DLS/DRS, over-rate penalties, forfeit/walkover, or any other on-field ruling that leads the competition to declare a winner are treated as ordinary wins.

eventMetadata.context_description: In a must-win IPL clash at spin-friendly Chepauk, Chennai Super Kings host Mumbai Indians with both sides languishing at 7th and 9th in the points table after eight matches, needing victories to revive slim playoff hopes. CSK's recent 103-run thrashing of MI in their April 23 encounter underscores their 5-1 head-to-head dominance since 2023, bolstered by home advantage where batting second has won 44% of games. Key absences shape sentiment: MI without injured Rohit Sharma and Mitchell Santner (Keshav Maharaj replacing), while CSK misses MS Dhoni (calf) and Ayush Mhatre; MI won the toss and batted first amid clear weather. Recent poor form for both highlights reliance on Ruturaj Gaikwad, Sanju Samson for CSK and Suryakumar Yadav, Will Jacks for MI, with spinners poised to exploit the turning pitch.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus on Polymarket's 2028 Democratic presidential nomination market favors California Gov. Gavin Newsom at 26.3% implied probability, driven by his national fundraising surge since late 2025, executive experience, and term-limited exit after the November 2026 midterms, positioning him as a steady frontrunner amid post-2024 party recalibration. Former Vice President Kamala Harris climbed to 10.8% after signaling a potential comeback bid on April 10 at the National Action Network and leading a Harvard CAPS/Harris poll (April 23-26) 50%-22% among Democrats, though markets diverge from this outlier showing trader skepticism over her 2024 loss. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez's 8.5% reflects progressive youth appeal, while Jon Ossoff (6.6%) and Pete Buttigieg (4.1%) benefit from Senate and prior campaign profiles. Consolidation awaits 2026 midterm results, early primary polling in Iowa and New Hampshire, and factional endorsements.

title: LoL: Invictus Gaming vs Anyone's Legend (BO3) - LPL Group Ascend
description:
This market refers to the LoL match between Invictus Gaming and Anyone's Legend in the LPL Group Ascend, initially scheduled for May 2 at 7:00AM ET.

This market will resolve to "Invictus Gaming" if Invictus Gaming win the match against Anyone's Legend.

This market will resolve to "Anyone's Legend" if Anyone's Legend win the match against Invictus Gaming.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date without a winner determined, this market will resolve to 50-50. 

If the match begins but is not completed, and one team wins due to the opponent's forfeiture, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to the team who wins. 

If the match ends in a forfeit, disqualification, or walkover (team withdraws before the start and the other wins automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50. 

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://gol.gg/esports/home. However, if https://gol.gg/esports/home has not published final results within 2 hours after the event’s conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

In cases where a team’s listed name includes minor discrepancies from the resolution source, this market will resolve based on the underlying real-world match rather than exact name matching. Recognizable abbreviations, alternate or erroneous spellings, sponsor tags, affiliate or academy designations, regional identifiers, and minor formatting differences will be treated as referring to the same team, provided the intended team can be clearly and uniquely identified within the relevant competition. If a listed team name has no reasonable connection to any participating team, or if it matches or could reasonably refer to another team in the same competition such that the intended team cannot be unambiguously determined, this market will resolve 50-50.

markets.question: Game 3: Both Teams Slay Baron Nashor?
markets.description:
This market is about whether both teams slay the Baron Nashor at least once during Game 3. Baron Nashor is a powerful neutral objective in League of Legends that first spawns at 20:00 game time and respawns 6 minutes after each death, granting the slaying team the Hand of Baron buff.

This market will resolve to "Yes" if both Invictus Gaming and Anyone's Legend each slay Baron Nashor at least once during Game 3. This market will resolve to "No" if either team (or both teams) does not slay Baron Nashor during Game 3.

If the match is canceled (not played at all) or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 3 is never played due to forfeit, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 3 is not played because the series result has already been determined (e.g., a team clinches the series before Game 3 is needed), this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 3 begins but is not completed and ends via surrender, this market will resolve based on whether both teams had slain Baron Nashor prior to stoppage. If the condition was not met, this market will resolve to "No".

If Game 3 is remade, resolution will be based on the remade game only.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://gol.gg/esports/home. However, if https://gol.gg/esports/home has not published final results within 2 hours after the event's conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

markets.question: Game 3: Both Teams Slay a Dragon?
markets.description:
This market is about whether both teams slay at least one elemental dragon during Game 3. After being slain, the next dragon spawns 5 minutes later. Once a team claims the Dragon Soul (by slaying four dragons), all subsequent dragon spawns become Elder Dragons.

This market will resolve to "Yes" if both Invictus Gaming and Anyone's Legend each slay at least one elemental dragon during Game 3. This market will resolve to "No" if either team (or both teams) does not slay any elemental dragon during Game 3. Only elemental dragons count toward this market — Elder Dragon kills do not count.

If Game 3 is never played due to forfeit, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to 50-50.

eventMetadata.context_description: Anyone's Legend holds a commanding position in LPL 2026 Split 2 Group Ascend standings at 6-3, bolstered by a recent 2-0 sweep over Top Esports that extended their win streak to four series, positioning them firmly in top-four playoff bracket contention amid the double round-robin BO3 format with Fearless Draft. Invictus Gaming languishes at 4-5, scrambling for play-in survival after a 2-1 win over Weibo Gaming but hampered by an earlier 0-2 loss to AL this split and overall inconsistent synergy from new additions like top laner Breathe and ADC JiaQi alongside veteran mid Rookie. AL's stable roster—Flandre, Tarzan, Shanks, Hope, Kael—excels in patch 26.7 meta favoring early aggression, giving them head-to-head edge in this rematch.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus on Polymarket prices Robert F. Kennedy Jr. at 49% implied probability to secure the 2028 Republican presidential nomination, driven by his high-visibility role as HHS Secretary in the Trump administration, where his advocacy on health policy and vaccine skepticism resonates with the GOP base amid ongoing confirmation-related buzz. Vice President J.D. Vance holds 39%, bolstered by incumbency advantages, strong CPAC straw poll leads (53%) and Yale youth surveys (43%), though recent YouGov polling shows a five-point drop signaling waning enthusiasm. Secretary of State Marco Rubio's 20.5% reflects fresh reports of Trump insiders privately pushing him as a successor amid Vance-Rubio ticket speculation, highlighting an early primary contest shaped by administration dynamics and party endorsements ahead of 2028 caucuses.

title: LoL: Team WE vs JD Gaming (BO3) - LPL Group Ascend
description:
This market refers to the LoL match between Team WE and JD Gaming in the LPL Group Ascend, initially scheduled for May 2 at 3:00AM ET.

This market will resolve to "Team WE" if Team WE win the match against JD Gaming.

This market will resolve to "JD Gaming" if JD Gaming win the match against Team WE.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date without a winner determined, this market will resolve to 50-50. 

If the match begins but is not completed, and one team wins due to the opponent's forfeiture, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to the team who wins. 

If the match ends in a forfeit, disqualification, or walkover (team withdraws before the start and the other wins automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50. 

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://gol.gg/esports/home. However, if https://gol.gg/esports/home has not published final results within 2 hours after the event’s conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

In cases where a team’s listed name includes minor discrepancies from the resolution source, this market will resolve based on the underlying real-world match rather than exact name matching. Recognizable abbreviations, alternate or erroneous spellings, sponsor tags, affiliate or academy designations, regional identifiers, and minor formatting differences will be treated as referring to the same team, provided the intended team can be clearly and uniquely identified within the relevant competition. If a listed team name has no reasonable connection to any participating team, or if it matches or could reasonably refer to another team in the same competition such that the intended team cannot be unambiguously determined, this market will resolve 50-50.

This market is about whether both teams destroy at least one enemy inhibitor during Game 3. In League of Legends, each team has three inhibitors (one in each lane), located behind the inner turrets.

This market will resolve to "Yes" if both Team WE and JD Gaming each destroy at least one enemy inhibitor during Game 3. This market will resolve to "No" if either team (or both teams) do not destroy any enemy inhibitors.

If the match is canceled (not played at all) or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 3 is never played due to forfeit, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 3 is not played because the series result has already been determined (e.g., a team clinches the series before Game 3 is needed), this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 3 begins but is not completed and ends via surrender, this market will resolve based on whether both teams destroyed at least one inhibitor prior to stoppage. If the condition was not met, this market will resolve to "No".

eventMetadata.context_description: JD Gaming holds a commanding edge in trader consensus for this LPL Split 2 Group Ascend BO3 rematch against Team WE, fueled by their 2-0 sweep over WE just one week ago on April 25, where jungler JunJia earned Player of the Match honors with dominant Jarvan IV plays. JDG rides a hot 5-1 streak across their last six series, contrasting WE's winless 0-6 skid and #36 world ranking, hampered by inconsistent macro and objective execution. Lifetime head-to-head tilts heavily JDG's way (20-7), amplified by superior roster depth featuring Xiaoxu top, GALA ADC, and stable midlane control from HongQ. Both squads chase seeding in the eight-team round-robin, with no reported injuries, subs, or patch-altering metas shifting dynamics pre-match.

eventMetadata.context_description: Mercedes' George Russell and rookie Kimi Antonelli lead trader consensus at 28.5% and 26.5% implied probabilities for the 2026 F1 Drivers' Championship, reflecting their tight intra-team battle atop the standings after three races—Antonelli on 72 points with wins in China and Japan, Russell close on 63 following victory in Australia. The Silver Arrows' superior pace, securing multiple 1-2 finishes and the constructors' lead, drives their dominance amid Red Bull's RB22 struggles with poor starts, excessive tyre wear, and inefficient energy recovery that have dropped Max Verstappen to just 3.5%. McLaren's Lando Norris (12.7%) and Oscar Piastri (9.3%), plus Ferrari's Charles Leclerc (9.2%), remain competitive threats as the long season heads to Miami, where consistency and reliability will test the closely bunched top contenders.

title: Counter-Strike: Natus Vincere vs FaZe (BO3) - BLAST Rivals Playoffs
description:
This market refers to the Counter-Strike Semifinal 1 match between Natus Vincere and FaZe in the BLAST Rivals Playoffs, initially scheduled for May 2 at 1:30PM ET.

This market will resolve to "Natus Vincere" if Natus Vincere win the match against FaZe.

This market will resolve to "FaZe" if FaZe win the match against Natus Vincere.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date without a winner determined, this market will resolve to 50-50. 

If the match begins but is not completed, and one team wins due to the opponent's forfeiture, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to the team who wins. 

If the match ends in a forfeit, disqualification, or walkover (team withdraws before the start and the other wins automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50. 

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://hltv.org. However, if https://hltv.org has not published final results within 2 hours after the event’s conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

In cases where a team’s listed name includes minor discrepancies from the resolution source, this market will resolve based on the underlying real-world match rather than exact name matching. Recognizable abbreviations, alternate or erroneous spellings, sponsor tags, affiliate or academy designations, regional identifiers, and minor formatting differences will be treated as referring to the same team, provided the intended team can be clearly and uniquely identified within the relevant competition. If a listed team name has no reasonable connection to any participating team, or if it matches or could reasonably refer to another team in the same competition such that the intended team cannot be unambiguously determined, this market will resolve 50-50.

eventMetadata.context_description: Natus Vincere enters this BLAST Rivals playoffs semifinal BO3 as the trader-favored side after dominating FaZe 2-0 in group stage on Anubis (13-7) and Ancient (13-11), with makazze's 1.46 rating underscoring their HLTV #2-ranked stability led by Aleksib's calls, iM, b1t, w0nderful. FaZe's transitional roster—Twistzz debuting as IGL post-karrigan's Falcons move, Neityu stand-in, new coach enkay J—struggled initially but ignited momentum through lower-bracket triumphs over FURIA (2-1) and a resilient 2-1 upset of G2 yesterday, frozen earning MVP honors at 1.28 rating. At Fort Worth LAN, map veto favoring Dust2 (FaZe pick), Ancient, and Anubis decider heightens upset potential for FaZe's aggressive resurgence against NaVi's form.

eventMetadata.context_description: Vice President JD Vance holds a slim edge in Polymarket's 2028 presidential winner market at 21.6% implied probability, reflecting trader consensus on his position as heir apparent to President Trump following the 2024 victory, bolstered by a March CPAC straw poll where he topped the GOP field and recent fundraising with major Republican donors. California Governor Gavin Newsom trails closely at 17.4%, buoyed by leads in early Democratic primary polls in California and a tie for second in New Hampshire surveys. Marco Rubio at 10.7% gains from his role as Secretary of State amid Iran tensions. The tight race persists due to the long timeline to November 2028, fluid primary fields, and pivotal 2026 midterms that could reshape paths to victory through incumbency advantages, endorsements, or midterm gains.

title: Elon Musk # tweets April 28 - May 5, 2026?
description:
This market will resolve according to the number of times Elon Musk (@elonmusk), posts on X from April 28 12:00 PM ET to May 5, 2026 12:00 PM ET.

For the purposes of this market, only main feed posts, quote posts and reposts will count.

Replies will NOT count towards the total - however, replies on the main feed such as https://x.com/elonmusk/status/1786073478711353576 will be counted by the tracker.

Deleted posts will count as long as they remain available long enough to be captured by the tracker (~5 minutes).

Community reposts which are not counted by the tracker not count toward the total.

The resolution source for this market is the 'Post Counter' figure for posts found at https://xtracker.polymarket.com. Individual posts can be viewed by clicking "Export Data". If the tracker does not update correctly in accordance with the rules, X itself may be used as a secondary resolution source.

Key differentiators include Musk's signature variability—fueled by real-time replies to immigration debates, demographic warnings like Italy's birth rate collapse, Grok AI benchmarks, and Starlink expansions—versus quieter stretches. With three days left, any Trump-related announcements or controversy could tip toward higher bins, while steady engagement favors the leaders.

title: LoL: Fnatic vs Team Heretics (BO3) - LEC Regular Season
description:
This market refers to the LoL match between Fnatic and Team Heretics in the LEC Regular Season, initially scheduled for May 2 at 11:00AM ET.

This market will resolve to "Fnatic" if Fnatic win the match against Team Heretics.

This market will resolve to "Team Heretics" if Team Heretics win the match against Fnatic.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date without a winner determined, this market will resolve to 50-50. 

If the match begins but is not completed, and one team wins due to the opponent's forfeiture, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to the team who wins. 

If the match ends in a forfeit, disqualification, or walkover (team withdraws before the start and the other wins automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50. 

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://gol.gg/esports/home. However, if https://gol.gg/esports/home has not published final results within 2 hours after the event’s conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

In cases where a team’s listed name includes minor discrepancies from the resolution source, this market will resolve based on the underlying real-world match rather than exact name matching. Recognizable abbreviations, alternate or erroneous spellings, sponsor tags, affiliate or academy designations, regional identifiers, and minor formatting differences will be treated as referring to the same team, provided the intended team can be clearly and uniquely identified within the relevant competition. If a listed team name has no reasonable connection to any participating team, or if it matches or could reasonably refer to another team in the same competition such that the intended team cannot be unambiguously determined, this market will resolve 50-50.

markets.question: Game 1: Both Teams Slay Baron Nashor?
markets.description:
This market is about whether both teams slay the Baron Nashor at least once during Game 1. Baron Nashor is a powerful neutral objective in League of Legends that first spawns at 20:00 game time and respawns 6 minutes after each death, granting the slaying team the Hand of Baron buff.

This market will resolve to "Yes" if both Fnatic and Team Heretics each slay Baron Nashor at least once during Game 1. This market will resolve to "No" if either team (or both teams) does not slay Baron Nashor during Game 1.

If the match is canceled (not played at all) or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 1 is never played due to forfeit, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 1 is not played because the series result has already been determined (e.g., a team clinches the series before Game 1 is needed), this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 1 begins but is not completed and ends via surrender, this market will resolve based on whether both teams had slain Baron Nashor prior to stoppage. If the condition was not met, this market will resolve to "No".

If Game 1 is remade, resolution will be based on the remade game only.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://gol.gg/esports/home. However, if https://gol.gg/esports/home has not published final results within 2 hours after the event's conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

markets.question: Game 1: Both Teams Slay a Dragon?
markets.description:

In League of Legends, elemental dragons (Infernal, Mountain, Ocean, Hextech, Chemtech, and Cloud) spawn in the dragon pit starting at 5:00 game time. After being slain, the next dragon spawns 5 minutes later. Once a team claims the Dragon Soul (by slaying four dragons), all subsequent dragon spawns become Elder Dragons.

This market will resolve to "Yes" if both Fnatic and Team Heretics each slay at least one elemental dragon during Game 1. This market will resolve to "No" if either team (or both teams) does not slay any elemental dragon during Game 1. Only elemental dragons count toward this market — Elder Dragon kills do not count.

If the match is canceled (not played at all) or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 1 is never played due to forfeit, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 1 is not played because the series result has already been determined (e.g., a team clinches the series before Game 1 is needed), this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 1 begins but is not completed and ends via surrender, this market will resolve based on whether both teams had slain at least one elemental dragon prior to stoppage. If the condition was not met, this market will resolve to "No".

If Game 1 is remade, resolution will be based on the remade game only.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://gol.gg/esports/home. However, if https://gol.gg/esports/home has not published final results within 2 hours after the event's conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

eventMetadata.context_description: Fnatic faces Team Heretics in a pivotal LEC regular season BO3 with playoff positioning on the line, as both squads battle inconsistencies late in the Spring Split. Fnatic arrives on a three-match skid after a 1-2 loss to undefeated Karmine Corp last week, dropping to around 2-4 amid macro execution woes despite strong individual plays from bot laner Upset and jungler Razork. Team Heretics sits lower in standings following a string of defeats, including 0-2 whitewashes, though they upset Fnatic in their February head-to-head (Fnatic leads series 9-4 overall). No roster changes or substitutions reported, spotlighting Fnatic's midlane edge with Vladi versus Heretics' aggressive top laner Tracyn; recent patch tweaks favor adaptable drafts in this mid-table clash.

title: Elon Musk # tweets April 30 - May 2, 2026?
description:
This market will resolve according to the number of times Elon Musk (@elonmusk), posts on X from April 30 12:00 PM ET to May 2, 2026 12:00 PM ET.

For the purposes of this market, only main feed posts, quote posts and reposts will count.

Replies will NOT count towards the total - however, replies on the main feed such as https://x.com/elonmusk/status/1786073478711353576 will be counted by the tracker.

Deleted posts will count as long as they remain available long enough to be captured by the tracker (~5 minutes).

Community reposts which are not counted by the tracker not count toward the total.

The resolution source for this market is the 'Post Counter' figure for posts found at https://xtracker.polymarket.com. Individual posts can be viewed by clicking "Export Data". If the tracker does not update correctly in accordance with the rules, X itself may be used as a secondary resolution source.

eventMetadata.context_description: Mirra Andreeva and Marta Kostyuk advanced to the Mutua Madrid Open WTA 1000 final on clay with gritty semifinal victories yesterday—Andreeva saving three set points to edge Hailey Baptiste 6-4, 7-6(10-8), and Kostyuk rallying from a 1-6 second-set dip against Anastasia Potapova 6-2, 6-1—highlighting their mental resilience under pressure. Kostyuk, No. 23 on a 10-match winning streak after Rouen and with a 7-6(7), 6-3 Brisbane head-to-head edge, brings powerful baseline aggression and recent Top-15 upsets like Jessica Pegula. No injuries reported; mild weather at Manolo Santana favors steady play in this first Madrid final for both.

title: US x Iran permanent peace deal by...?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if Iran and the United states agree to a permanent peace deal by the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”. 

A permanent peace deal refers to any agreement which explicitly indicates that military hostilities between the United States and Iran have ended or will permanently cease, or uses equivalent language clearly signaling a lasting end to military hostilities between the United States and Iran. Agreements that are explicitly temporary or which do not include a definitive agreement to end military hostilities between the US and Iran on a lasting basis (e.g. a temporary extension of the two-week ceasefire agreement announced on April 7, 2026), will not qualify.

A qualifying agreement will be considered to have been established if either of the following conditions are met:

- The United States and Iran each sign or formally adopt a written agreement (e.g. a treaty or multi-point agreement) which meets the above criteria.

- Both the governments of the United States and Iran provide clear public confirmation that a qualifying agreement has been definitively established. Negotiations, statements of progress, or other statements which do not constitute a definitive announcement that a qualifying agreement has been reached will not count.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from the governments of the United States and Iran; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

Traders weigh diplomatic breakthroughs against risks of renewed hostilities, with no confirmed meetings scheduled despite War Powers Act pressures on the administration.

title: Next French Presidential Election
description:
The next French presidential election is currently expected to be held around April 2027.  This market pertains to the outcome of the next French presidential election, regardless of whether it follows the scheduled end of the current term or is held earlier.

This market will resolve based on the result of the election as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the French Government, specifically the Ministry of the Interior (https://www.interieur.gouv.fr/).

eventMetadata.context_description: Recent polls from late March 2026, including Elabe, Odoxa, and OpinionWay, position National Rally president Jordan Bardella as the first-round leader at 34-38% in the 2027 French presidential election, slightly ahead of Horizons leader and former prime minister Édouard Philippe at 18-25%, driving trader consensus on Polymarket where Bardella holds a slim 22% edge. Philippe's municipal reelection as Le Havre mayor boosted his profile, and runoff scenarios show him narrowly defeating Bardella 51.5-52% to 48-48.5%, amid RN's failure to seize major cities despite strong national support. A fragmented field—split across left-wing figures like Jean-Luc Mélenchon and center options—keeps the race tight one year out, with political fatigue noted in April surveys signaling desire for change. Consolidations, endorsements, Marine Le Pen's legal appeals, or economic shifts could separate frontrunners before the April 2027 two-round vote.
